integrity: The infinite theorem is proved by a carry/valuation decomposition. Computational checks corroborate finite cases and are not treated as infinite certification. The prior paper explicitly left exhaustion open; unindexed independent earlier work remains possible.
scientific_limitations: Parity all-one binary block-counting family only; run-length and frequency measures combine zeros and ones; zero-only completeness combines new exclusion with credited published existence constructions. No claim for general patterns or higher alphabets.
title: Complete constant-run spectra and exact frequencies for all-one block-parity words
